invariants.safety: For every admissible prefix, all operations stay in the stated range and chronology; no unsupported numerical certificate.
invariants.fidelity: Every certified quantity has a sound bound relative to its declared reference, uniform in runtime.
invariants.retention: With unchanged valid parameters, weak use must preserve earlier certified constraints to declared resolution; arithmetic loss is not evidence aging.
invariants.usefulness: Name informative stream/prefix conditions under which supported estimates or updates remain useful. Do not require uniform adaptation delay after arbitrary unbounded historical weight; do not count perpetual unavailable as success.
invariants.transition: The same invariant covers ingestion, seal/merge, snapshot/query, chart change and supported recovery; error budgets are not restarted.
invariants.no_double_counting: Old/new factors remain source-disjoint; no posterior-as-prior plus replay of its source observations.

theorem_template.initialization: Exact reference s0 belongs to Gamma(machine_state0).
theorem_template.inductive_step: For every admissible u, F(Gamma(machine_state),u) subset Gamma(machine_transition(machine_state,u)).
theorem_template.conclusion: Containment for all finite n by induction, plus separately proved useful resolution under declared conditions.
theorem_template.nonvacuity: Gamma equal to the entire domain forever or terminal failure alone does not satisfy the estimator goal.
